name: Follow That Kobold!

angles.text: As a Hunter, you meet Tordrin Sternblade, a veteran Hunter trainer newly arrived from Ironforge to assist Northshire Abbey.
As a dwarf, you bring traditional dwarven tracking expertise from Ironforge to help the humans of Northshire.
As an Alliance member, you see Stormwind's holy abbey and an Ironforge mountaineer support one another.

faq.answer: A kobold fled Northshire Valley's mine with a heavy sack of Brother Paxton's stolen books. The abbey wants them returned.
faq.q: What is Follow That Kobold! about?

faq.answer: Tordrin Sternblade is a dwarven Hunter trainer newly arrived from Ironforge. He is behind Northshire Abbey near the stables, where his tracking skill can help recover the books.
Kelsey reports that a kobold slipped out of the Northshire mine tunnels with a large sack of books. The human tomes belong to Brother Paxton, and the abbey needs them returned.
Kelsey Fargo, the new mining apprentice who works right outside the Northshire mine, reported the theft. She noticed a kobold leaving the tunnels with a sack stuffed with books.
Brother Paxton is a cleric at Northshire Abbey. The stolen library materials belong to him or his sacred duties, so the abbey calls for an experienced tracker to recover them.

aliases: how do i track the kobold
faq.answer: You are warned against charging blindly into the woods and sent to consult Tordrin Sternblade behind the abbey. His wilderness knowledge can help you track the thief.
faq.q: How do you track the thieving kobold?

sections.body: Kelsey saw a kobold flee the Northshire Abbey mine tunnels with a heavy sack of books. The workers and clerics thought the vermin in the mines were under control. The books belong to Brother Paxton, who needs them back in the abbey's collection.
sections.title: The Book Thief of Northshire

sections.body: The kobold is a nimble scavenger from below ground. Tracking it through Northshire Abbey's wooded grounds calls for special skill. You are sent behind the abbey to the stables, where Tordrin Sternblade can be found. The dwarven Hunter trainer has newly arrived from Ironforge, and his wilderness knowledge can help pick up the kobold's scent.
sections.title: Calling in the Mountaineer

summary: A kobold has fled Northshire's mines with Brother Paxton's books, and the abbey calls on Tordrin Sternblade to track it. Follow That Kobold! begins with a theft from the local mines.
